column1: # meshcomod_boot SHARED partition table — DUAL-SLOT (A/B) + factory recovery
# 16 MB. The custom bootloader boots `factory` (the recovery) by DEFAULT and the
# otadata-selected ota slot ONCE when a launcher raises the `bootsel` one-shot
# flag (then clears it). So recovery-first is enforced by the BOOTLOADER
# app — it holds for ANY firmware in a slot (meshcomod
# build). otadata still selects WHICH ota slot (A/B)
#   - meshcomod OTA writes the spare slot + sets otadata -> reboot -> recovery
#   - recovery "Boot firmware"/"Add firmware" sets otadata + raises bootsel.
#   ota_0    @0x110000 (3.25 MB) ┐ A/B meshcomod app slots
#   tiles / spiffs              : map-tile cache + user data (found by LABEL)
# Updating either component is a fixed-offset esptool write (factory @0x10000
# ota_0 @0x110000); each preserves the other + nvs/tiles/spiffs.
